text: Vemurafenib is a potent, ATP-competitive small-molecule inhibitor specifically designed to target the oncogenic BRAF V600E mutant kinase. The V600E substitution destabilizes the inactive conformation of the BRAF kinase domain, locking it into a constitutively active monomeric state that hyperactivates the downstream MEK/ERK signaling pathway to drive melanoma cell proliferation. Vemurafenib selectively binds to the active ATP-binding pocket of BRAF V600E, inhibiting its kinase activity, suppressing ERK phosphorylation, and triggering apoptosis in BRAF V600E-mutant melanoma cells.
